reviews.text: I'm always so happy with how cute you finish my hair!

I've brought my dog ​​in for grooming many times. The staff are always so kind and attentive, so I feel completely at ease leaving my dog ​​there.

They always listen carefully to my requests, and the results are always adorable – I'm extremely happy! 🐶✨

Thank you for your continued support.

Everyone is so kind, and I feel completely at ease leaving my child with you.

We used their short-term childcare service. They share photos and videos of our child playing happily with other children. They were running a campaign and we won the first prize: a large food bowl! Our child, who is usually a picky eater, now finishes all their food, probably because it's easy to eat from. We'll be using their grooming service again soon.
I came back because I was happy with the results last time!
It's been three years since we moved here, and the staff are so kind and play with our dog Sakura 🐶 a lot, so I'm happy that she enjoys going there 💓👍 …
I seemed a bit excited, but they did their best to accommodate me while taking my health into consideration. I'll definitely use their services again.

This was my first time using this service.
I usually only ask the salon to express my dog's anal glands and trim his paws, which are things I can't do myself. I was looking for a place nearby that could do this, and it was helpful to be able to make a reservation even on the day.
I would definitely like to use this service again.
I always use their services for grooming and part-time childcare, and the staff are very kind and polite, so I feel comfortable leaving my dog ​​in their care.

I always ask them to trim my dog, and everyone there is so kind and seems to love animals, so I can leave him with peace of mind! Many of them are good at cutting, and they can even give me the cute, trendy cut I want, so I'm grateful!
I'm very satisfied.

My dog ​​was a fluffy little monster before grooming, but afterwards she transformed into an incredibly cute princess 😂
The staff were super kind, the shop was clean, and the service was excellent! Highly recommended! …

I used their hotel and grooming services.

For the hotel stay, they posted pictures of my dog's walks on Instagram and we could communicate via message, which gave me peace of mind.

It's a shame the prices increased in April, but my dog ​​loves it and it's become a destination for our walks.

I appreciate how kind the staff are.

Do they delete bad reviews? I went to get my dog ​​groomed right when they opened, but I had to wait outside in the freezing cold for 30 minutes. I asked them about it and they said the train was delayed, but I don't think they should delay opening for that reason. They didn't even apologize. Everyone around me said they weren't very good at cutting dogs. Do they treat owners and dogs differently? I felt like I was being made fun of. I'll never go there again.
I always rely on your dental care services. All the staff are so kind, and I've gradually gotten used to brushing my teeth, which I used to hate. Thank you so much!

We were able to use the free dog run.

Besides the dog run, hotel, and daycare, they also seem to have a wide selection of supplies, so we'd like to visit again.

We first used it at a hotel!

Our usually calm dog had a fantastic time, and we're very happy with the experience. I highly recommend the T-BONE dental ring sold here.
I'm grateful to all the staff for always treating me so kindly. I look forward to them stopping by to play every day on their walks. I also use their tooth brushing service. Thank you very much!

This was my second visit.

My dog ​​was given a very thorough shampoo.

When I went to pick him up after the shampoo, he was happily playing in the spacious indoor area that I could see from outside the shop.

I think it's a very enjoyable place for dogs too.

I would like to use their services again.

I go there regularly to brush my teeth.

The staff are all kind and provide excellent service!

The staff are always so kind and helpful, which makes me feel at ease using their services.
The shop has a bright atmosphere, and it's nice that you can see inside from the outside.
I always have to make last-minute requests due to work, but they always respond courteously. Thank you! 😊! …

I always use the short-term childcare service. During the hot summer months, it's difficult to take the dogs outside, so it's a real lifesaver to be able to let them play freely in a comfortable indoor environment. I'm always grateful to …

We always use this salon for grooming our three dogs.
First of all, the staff are very kind.
And above all, their cutting skills are very high. They even give designer cuts to toy poodles in a cute style that suits each dog!
He came to the dog run, played with his friends, and smelled all the different dogs, which made him so excited. I'd love to come back and play again.
I used the limited-time free indoor dog run for the first time. It was just the right size for a small dog.
I contacted them on the day and was able to use their indoor dog run. They were very accommodating, and I would like to consider using their other services in the future.
